text.en:
While <solar/>Radiant, Powered Melee kills grant 100% Melee Ability Energy after a 0.2 second delay. Melees that grant <solar/>Radiant will still trigger a refund if a kill is achieved in the same blow.

Passively grants benefits to your equipped <solar/>Solar Super:
• <solar/>Marksman Golden Gun duration is increased by 4 seconds
• <solar/>Deadshot Golden Gun is granted 15% damage resistance
• <solar/>Blade Barrage fires 3 additional knives per wave (14🠚20 Total Knives)

Casting your super grants <solar/>Cure x1.
